title: RunConcept
description: A reusable run concept (Power, Counter, Inside Zone, etc.) that multiple play files can reference via run_concept_ref.

concept_id.description: Stable identifier (kebab-case). Must match the filename (without .yaml).

description.description: 1-3 sentence explanation of the concept — what the blocking looks like, where the HB aims, when to use it.

aim_point.description: Specific gap or zone the ball carrier attacks. Use letter-gap notation (A/B/C/D-gap) or a descriptor like 'off-tackle' or 'perimeter'.

read_tree.description: Ordered list of post-snap reads the ball carrier makes. Phase 1 is the first (fastest) decision.

phase.description: Read order (1 = first decision point at snap/handoff).

defender.description: The defensive player or assignment being read (e.g. 'playside EDGE', 'playside ILB', 'backside DE').

decision.description: What the ball carrier does based on this defender's action.

blocking_scheme_ref.description: Foreign key into data/concepts/blocking-schemes/ — the primary OL blocking scheme for this concept.

pulls_required.description: OL positions that pull on this concept. Empty list if no pulls.

lead_blocker.description: Skill-position player (FB, TE, HB) who leads through the hole. Omit if no designated lead blocker.

pairs_with.description: IDs of complementary concepts or formations that pair well with this one.
